title: 第3764章 冰霜绝境鬼狱裁决第3763章 渊临鬼城魂逃追击
content_zh:
第3764章冰霜绝境，鬼狱裁决
谢飞张口喷出一大口鲜血。
刷！！
傅临渊的身影骤然出现在他面前，身侧凝聚一条巨大的狰狞鬼臂掐住谢飞的脖子。
傅临渊居高临下的看着谢飞，脸上露出一丝讥讽之色。
“你胆子很大啊？”
谢飞恐惧茫然地看着傅临渊，双手扒着那鬼手拼命摇头。
他不知道对方在说什么……
傅临渊也不在乎他到底知不知道。
鬼手猛地用力！
砰！！
谢飞的脑袋就像炸裂的西瓜般爆裂开来！
神魂飘荡，同样被那鬼手一拳轰杀！！
转身的傅临渊嗤笑一声。
“擅自修改生死簿，按《幽冥律》当诛。”
扑通！
身后众修被吓得瑟瑟发抖，跪在地上不敢抬头。
傅临渊随手对着身后的鬼差指了点。
“从今天起，这座鬼门关由你们二人负责。”
被点到的两名鬼差躬身行礼，不敢有半点异议。

傅临渊抬头看了一眼这座鬼门关，抬手凝聚冥蕴之力勾连其法器。
不消片刻，他手里便凝聚出一本黄色的‘生死簿’，丢给了那两名鬼差。
与此同时，李观棋等人面对两大主境骷髅守卫的追杀一路逃亡！
在两大守卫的攻击之下，众人显得十分狼狈。
如今骨罗天和北冥鱼刚刚签订同生共死契。
北冥鱼重创，骨罗天的气息也在不断跌落。
若不是吞了好几颗塑魂丹，恐怕都要坚持不住了。
那姓傅的修士实力实在太恐怖了……
身为冥修，竟然身具雷系的力量。
结合其阴司勾魂使的力量，每一击都蕴含着无比威能。
李观棋飞身闪烁，一把拽飞孟婉舒，抬手一剑回击。
轰！！！
雷光炸裂，抛飞而出的孟婉舒在空中一脚踹在叶峰的脚掌之上。
二人分开的瞬间，一式刀芒一闪而过，将脚下大地炸开一大片。
骨罗天抱着北冥鱼，眼眸闪烁，脑海中疯狂思索着可有术法神通能够破开眼前困局。
content_en:
Chapter 3764 Frost Desperate Situation, Ghost Prison Judgment
Xie Fei opened his mouth and spat out a large mouthful of blood.
brush! !
Fu Linyuan's figure suddenly appeared in front of him, and a huge ferocious ghost arm condensed beside him and strangled Xie Fei's neck.
Fu Linyuan looked at Xie Fei condescendingly, with a trace of sarcasm on his face.
"Are you very brave?"
Xie Fei looked at Fu Linyuan in fear and confusion, holding the ghost hand with both hands and shaking his head desperately.
He doesn't know what the other person is talking about...
Fu Linyuan didn't care whether he knew or not.
The ghost hand exerted force violently!
Bang! !
Xie Fei's head exploded like an exploding watermelon!
His soul was wandering, but he was also punched to death by the ghost hand! !
Fu Linyuan turned around and sneered.
"If you modify the book of life and death without authorization, you will be punished according to the Law of the Netherworld."
Thump!
The cultivators behind him were so frightened that they knelt on the ground and did not dare to raise their heads.
Fu Linyuan casually pointed at the ghost behind him.
"From today on, you two will be responsible for this hell gate."
The two ghost officers who were called out bowed and saluted, not daring to have the slightest objection.
Fu Linyuan raised his head and glanced at this ghost gate, then raised his hand to gather the power of the underworld to connect its magic weapon.
Within a moment, a yellow 'Book of Life and Death' condensed in his hand and he threw it to the two ghost servants.
At the same time, Li Guanqi and others faced the pursuit of two skeleton guards in the main realm and fled all the way!
Under the attack of the two guards, everyone looked very embarrassed.
Now Gu Luotian and Bei Mingyu have just signed a life-and-death contract.
Bei Mingyu was severely injured, and Gu Luotian's aura was also declining.
If he hadn't swallowed several soul-shaping pills, he might not have been able to hold on.
The strength of the monk named Fu is really terrifying...
As a meditator, he actually possesses the power of thunder.
Combined with the power of the Yinsi Soul Seducer, every strike contains incomparable power.
Li Guanqi flew forward in a flash, dragged Meng Wanshu away, raised his hand and struck back with a sword.
boom! ! !
The thunder exploded, and Meng Wanshu was thrown into the air and kicked Ye Feng on the sole of his foot.
The moment the two separated, a sword flashed past, exploding a large area of ​​the ground beneath their feet.
Gu Luotian hugged Bei Mingyu, his eyes twinkling, and he was thinking crazily in his mind about whether there was any magic or magical power that could break the predicament in front of him.
